第3061章 一力破万法尸皇通灵术（第1页）
一力破万法，尸皇通灵术！（一力破万法，尸皇通灵术！（第22页）风祖，兵祖等人被逼退之后面面相觑。“不是！”“他有病吧？”“不装逼他会死吗？”“他到底为什么怕咱们出手啊，帮忙不好吗。”天音祖师也是服了，这血魔古祖精神病吧，怎么浪成这样。其他黑暗古祖也是表情精彩。若是风祖等人帮这血魔古祖的忙，祂们还是要忌惮三分的，结果这大傻子，竟然还把送上门的队友赶走了。这不纯纯大沙比吗。“桀桀桀。”此时血魔古祖已经猖狂笑着，主动杀入灰河之中。“？？？”两方人马更是惊呆了。明知道那里是灰河古祖的主场，还敢直接横冲直撞杀过去？“哗啦，哗啦——”灰河之水奔腾不止，水花炸开，仿若水中有着一尊混世魔王，搅风搅雨，一尊尊骇人腐败的无上生灵被轰穿身躯，炸飞出来。那血色身躯，气力无双，神挡杀神，佛挡杀佛，单凭气力罡风，就足以撕碎诡异的无上道则凝聚的防御。至于那些无上生灵的攻击手段，甚至难以破开洛凡尘的防御。“卧槽！”“苍龙道友这么猛？”山海之主感觉自己这一辈子体魄都白修了。这才是力修的尽头和终极梦想啊！风祖等人都以为洛凡尘要吃大苦头，哪里想到会出现这种画面。面对灰河之力的压制，迎着这么多诡异无上强者的围攻，愣是跟没事人一样，莽无敌。“我们来帮你！”邪藤古祖呼喊，就要上前助阵。灰河古祖面色难看：“你们都别过来。”“本座堂堂天祖庙第十五龛位强者，收拾不了咱们黑暗一脉突然冒出来的无名之辈？”“黄泉尸魔手！”灰河古祖持续发力，黄泉尸水天上来，混合灰河之力凝聚出一双双黄泉尸手，在灰河之中伸出，密密麻麻的抓向洛凡尘，要将他拉入灰河深处。“嚓嚓嚓——”那一双双尸手的确霸道，可以隔空锁定敌人，干枯发黑，流淌尸水的手掌抓住洛凡尘四肢，甚至是脖颈，开始散发出腐蚀性极强的无上诡道规则。“你完了！”灰河之主面上流露出狞笑。“哦？”洛凡尘挑眉：“力道差太多了。”此时的他，明面上是血影仙在硬悍灰河古祖，实际上混沌，祭灵，功德，灵魂，肉身，五尊融合了无上仙城的无上之躯也在血影仙体内，持续发力。论力量单混沌无上之躯在二十阶后期领域里就可以达到极致，更不要说此刻还是六大无上之躯合一，简直所向披靡，无所畏惧。“都滚开！”“砰——”黄泉尸魔手的确霸道，但架不住洛凡尘力大无穷，一力破万法，所有尸手尽数崩裂开来。“都给本祖跪下！”血魔古祖全身爆发出凶猛巨力，形成巨大推力，硬生生将所有灰河之水逼退，在河流中央形成一片真空地带，仿若上古魔神。那一尊尊从死亡中复苏的无上生灵颤栗，竟是不受灰河古祖控制，尽数跪倒在河流之中，向着那一尊无敌力之王者臣服。“不……”“这不可能！”“二十阶后期怎会有如此巨力！”灰河古祖难以置信，这个时候不敢托大，哪里还顾得上脸面：“快，快快！”“这家伙不对劲，你们九个一起上！”

Breaking through all the magic with one force, the Corpse Emperor's psychic technique! (Break all magic with one force, Corpse Emperor's psychic technique! (Page 22) Feng Zu, Bing Zu and others looked at each other in shock after being forced back. "No!" "Is he sick?" "Will he die if he doesn't show off?" "Why on earth is he afraid of us? Let's take action, why don't we help?" Patriarch Tianyin was also convinced. This ancient blood demon ancestor must be mentally ill. How could he be like this? The other dark ancestors also had wonderful expressions. If Ancestor Feng and others help this ancient blood demon ancestor, he We still have to be wary of three points, but this fool actually drove away his teammates. Isn’t this pure Dashabi? "???" The two parties were even more shocked. They knew that this was the home ground of the Gray River Ancestor, but they dared to charge directly into it? There is a demon king in the water, stirring up the wind and rain, and the terrifying and corrupt supreme creatures are blasted through the body and blown out. The blood-colored body has unparalleled strength. Gods can kill gods, and Buddhas can kill Buddhas. Just rely on the strength of the wind. It's enough to tear apart the defense of the strange Supreme Dao. As for the attack methods of those supreme beings, it is even difficult to break through Luo Fanchen's defense. "Fuck!" "Friend Canglong is so powerful?" The Lord of Mountains and Seas felt ashamed. My whole life's physical training has been in vain. This is the end of my cultivation and my ultimate dream! Feng Zu and others thought that Luo Fanchen would suffer a lot, but they never expected that such a scene would happen. Facing the suppression of Huihe's power and the siege of so many strange and powerful men, he was as invincible as anyone. "We are here to help you!" Ancient Ancestor Xie Teng shouted, and he was about to step forward to help. "Don't come here." The powerful man in the fifteenth niche of Tianzu Temple can't deal with the unknown people from our dark lineage who suddenly appeared? The force condensed into pairs of corpse hands, stretched out from the gray river, and grabbed Luo Fanchen tightly, trying to pull him into the depths of the gray river. "Chachacha—" Those pairs of corpse hands were indeed overbearing and could lock on the enemy from a distance. , withered and black hands, dripping with corpse water, grabbed Luo Fanchen's limbs and even his neck, and began to emit extremely corrosive rules of the supreme trick. "You are finished!" The Lord of Gray River showed a ferocious smile. "Oh?" Luo Fanchen raised his eyebrows: "There's too much difference in strength." At this time, on the surface, he was the Blood Shadow Immortal and the powerful Huihe Ancient Ancestor. In fact, the five bodies of Chaos, Spirit Sacrifice, Merit, Soul, and Flesh merged into the Supreme Immortal City. He is also continuing to exert force in the body of the Blood Shadow Immortal. In terms of strength, the supreme body of chaos can reach the extreme in the realm of the late 20th level, not to mention that at this moment, the six supreme bodies are simply invincible and fearless. "Get away!" "Bang -" Huang Quan's corpse demon hands are indeed domineering, but they can't hold back Luo Fanchen. With one force, all the corpse hands are shattered. The ferocious force exploded, forming a huge thrust, forcing all the water of the Gray River back, forming a vacuum zone in the middle of the river, like an ancient demon. The supreme beings who had risen from death trembled, and they all fell to their knees in the river, surrendering to the invincible king of the Gray River. "No..." "This is impossible!" "How can there be such a huge power in the late twentieth level!"I believe that I don’t dare to make excuses at this time, because I don’t care about my face: “Quick, quick!” “There’s something wrong with this guy, all nine of you come together!”
